data.name: Will of the Mountainhopper
data.detailed_description:
Will of the Mountainhopper blends classic adventure game charm with fast-paced, real-time combat and light survival mechanics.

Discover the foggy mountain ranges and expansive plains of Hopsbrook, a province mostly wild and sparsely populated. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and search for tools and weapons among the ruins of abandoned settlements. Craft, improvise, and survive with whatever you can find.

Dangerous foes and perhaps a few unexpected allies await you. But you must keep moving. War looms on the horizon, and the letter you carry may be the land's final hope.

KEY FEATURES

  • Classic 2.5D exploration with hand-drawn art and nostalgic charm,

  • Solve puzzles and uncover ancient secrets across ruins and wildlands,

  • Engage in real-time combat against animals, enemies, and unknown threats,

  • Scavenge and craft gear from whatever you can find in the environment,

  • Journey with your loyal dog companion, Roshko,

  • A heartfelt coming-of-age tale set against the backdrop of a looming war.

STORRY SUMMARY

The young shepherd Miro, along with his loyal dog Roshko, finally returns to his mountain village of Skrejen. He had spent the harsh winter months guiding the family’s sheep to the lowlands, seeking shelter until the cold passed.

With all the animals safe, Miro comes home—only to find the village seized and burned to the ground by an unknown military force. Not a living soul remains, and his family and friends are nowhere to be found.

While searching the rubble, Miro stumbles upon a gravely injured stranger who calls himself The Mountainhopper. Mysterious and enigmatic, the man seeks redemption and entrusts Miro with a sealed letter: a critical document that may decide the outcome of the war to come.

Miro now carries the power to stop the growing disaster—and the key to finding his missing family.

data.short_description: A hand-animated action adventure with a pinch of Eastern European folklore. Explore a 2.5D environment as you solve puzzles and mysteries, engage with a challenging real-time combat, and gather and craft useful items for your survival. Will you manage to prevent the coming war and save your family?
